title: Propagate encoding_errors to _BytesIOWrapper for text buffers in read_csv
answers: Why does pd.read_csv ignore encoding_errors when reading a StringIO with engine='c' or engine='pyarrow'?
How to fix UnicodeEncodeError in read_csv with text buffers and custom encoding_errors?
Where does pandas wrap text buffers to binary streams for C and pyarrow CSV parsers?
body:
Symptom: pd.read_csv on a text buffer (such as StringIO) raises UnicodeEncodeError instead of respecting encoding_errors under the C or pyarrow engines.
Root cause: pandas/io/common.py:_BytesIOWrapper encoded text without an errors handler, and pandas/io/common.py:get_handle omitted errors when initializing the wrapper.
Fix pattern: Propagate the errors parameter from get_handle into _BytesIOWrapper and pass it to str.encode in _BytesIOWrapper.read.
Constraints: Applies when engines requiring binary input (C, pyarrow) read text-mode buffers via _BytesIOWrapper; does not apply to python engine which reads text directly.
applies: pandas/io/common.py when wrapping text buffers for binary CSV parsers
